items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: James was a teacher and more of a band leader. And more of an instructor and a band leader.

ctx.x: James was a teacher and more of a band leader. And more of an instructor and a band leader. And it all comes to playing on the trumpet.
What about his brother? You know his brother? Played fiddle, Wendell?
